text:
[issue by JunkJaguar]
### Minecraft Version

1.20.1

### What happened?

What I changed
![Image](https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/24df4b29-0ec0-4ef8-98c1-aeaae6b25375)

![Image](https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/45069825-c2c3-47f6-96c0-cdde8f68dc84)

This is my third attempt. On my first, I was recording (screen sharing) via discord, so I stopped that closed out of everything, and tried again (launching the modpack through curse forge). At first it worked, but when I created a new world (creative) and looked at the slots I had, it was defaulted back to one for each. So I closed out of the game and went back to the common config to see what was wrong. Everything was the same as the first image I shared. So I saved it, closed the file and tried again, but this time I got the error message, but I'm not recording this time. 

This is my first time trying to edit the slot amount in curios, I followed the directions on the configuration page, and I'm not sure where I went wrong.

### Relevant Log Outputs

[Crash Report](https://pastebin.com/RHZnmbNG)

[comment by TheIllusiveC4 (owner)]
I think the issue is the quotation marks. Based on the crash log, the quotes you have around each entry are not actually quotes. It appears to be a different character that resembles quotes. I'm not sure how that happened, perhaps a copy-paste error if that's what you did? In any case, replacing those with regular quotes should solve this issue.
